description_en: Lists the subfolders or workflow drafts within a specified workflow draft folder
description_zh: 列出某一个工作流草稿文件夹下的子文件夹或工作流草稿
name: GetExperimentFolderChildren

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent folder whose members you want to list. Set this parameter to root to specify the root directory
parameters.help_zh: 要列出成员的父文件夹ID，假如是root表示是根目录
parameters.name: folder_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to list only folders
parameters.name: only_folder

parameters.help_en:
The visibility within the workspace. Valid values:
PRIVATE: Visible only to you and administrators in this workspace.
PUBLIC: Visible to all users in this workspace
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en: If FolderId is set to root and Accessibility is set to PRIVATE, this parameter specifies the owner of the private root path. Default value: the current visitor
parameters.help_zh: 若FolderId为root，Accessibility为PRIVATE，这里代表私有根路径的所有者，默认为访问者自己
parameters.name: user_id

Empty.description_en: Indicates whether the folder is empty

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The creation time in UTC, in ISO 8601 format
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The modification time in UTC, in ISO 8601 format
GmtModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改时间，UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601

Icon.description_en: The icon used by the workflow draft or workflow draft folder. Valid values: icon-folder and icon-pipelinedraft
Icon.description_zh: 工作流草稿或工作流草稿文件夹使用的图标，目前有icon-folder，icon-pipelinedraft

Id.description_en: The ID of the workflow draft or workflow draft folder
Id.description_zh: 工作流草稿或工作流草稿文件夹的ID

Name.description_en: The name of the workflow draft or workflow draft folder
Name.description_zh: 工作流草稿或工作流草稿文件夹的名称

Type.description_en:
The type. Valid values:
pipelinedraft: a workflow draft.
dir: a workflow draft folder
Type.description_zh:
目前有两种类型：
pipelinedraft：工作流草稿
dir：工作流草稿文件夹

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
